sloka: ते वानरा भग्नहतावशेषाः पर्यन्तमाश्रित्य तदा विषण्णाः।प्रवेपिताङ्गं ददृशुः सुघोरं नरेन्द्ररक्षोधिपसन्निपातम् ।। ६.६७.१४६ ।।
transliteration: te vānarā bhagnahatāvaśeṣāḥ paryantamāśritya tadā viṣaṇṇāḥ।pravepitāṅgaṁ dadṛśuḥ sughoraṁ narendrarakṣodhipasannipātam ।। 6.67.146 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Rama spoke to Kumbhakarna, whose hands were like Vasuki's body, coming towards him to attack on the battlefield like a cloud chased by wind.
